answer: Pay is held until a random later recall: without warning, an identity must climb back to the summit of a past job and re-derive it live, answering follow-ups that twist one condition. Honest makers keep the tacit steps, like a lagoon keeper who knows where the channel silts; a farm that copied a finished answer hears only a whisper of it and cannot rebuild the reasoning under the twist. Each clone therefore needs a real maker who learned its work, so copying stops being cheap and the operator's learning cost grows with every fake.
